summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that supervisory board member Alexandra Reich will resign effective September 1, 2026, citing a desire to rebalance priorities. Reich, appointed in April 2023, served on the Risk, ESG, and Technology and Operations Committees. The departure is voluntary and routine, not abrupt or forced. The announcement includes standard board thanks and no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, restructuring, or strategic changes. This is a routine board member transition disclosure, not a special situation.
